```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a pairplot of the dataset to visualize the distribution of features for each species
pairplot = sns.pairplot(df, hue='species', markers=["o", "s", "D"],
                        palette='Set2', diag_kind='kde')

# Add a title to the pairplot
pairplot.fig.suptitle('Pairplot of Iris Dataset by Species', y=1.02)

# Save the figure
pairplot.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
